scope: Synthetic fixture; agent template binder -> ClickHouse-to-Trino converter -> live local Trino VALUES relation. No production employee data.
checks: Salary mean/median 150000; Hourly mean/median annual estimate 78000 and average rate 37.5; distribution sums 100 per pay type; Eng alone above each pay-type company average; default Active+On Leave excludes terminated fixture; unknown pay basis NULL.

results.sql: SELECT employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN annual_salary WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) AS "Average Annual Compensation", avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary ELSE NULL END) AS "Average Hourly Rate" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee WHERE (employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) GROUP BY employee_pay_type

SELECT e.employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", CASE WHEN 'company' = 'department' THEN e.department_name WHEN 'company' = 'status' THEN e.employee_status ELSE 'Company' END AS "Group", count((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Known Compensation Count", (quantileExactLow(0.5)((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) + quantileExactHigh(0.5)((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END))) / 2 AS "Exact Median Annual Compensation", avg((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Average Annual Compensation", min((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Minimum Annual Compensation", max((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Maximum Annual Compensation", avg(CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary ELSE NULL END) AS "Average Hourly Rate" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee AS e WHERE (e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) AND TRUE AND TRUE AND NOT ((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) IS NULL) AND ('recorded' = 'recorded' OR (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) > 0) GROUP BY e.employee_pay_type, CASE WHEN 'company' = 'department' THEN e.department_name WHEN 'company' = 'status' THEN e.employee_status ELSE 'Company' END ORDER BY "Group"

SELECT employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", department_name AS department, AVG((CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN annual_salary WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS average_annual_compensation, COUNT(DISTINCT employee_code) AS headcount, avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary ELSE NULL END) AS "Average Hourly Rate" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee WHERE TRUE AND (employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) GROUP BY employee_pay_type, department_name

SELECT avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN annual_salary ELSE NULL END) AS company_salary_avg, avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) AS company_hourly_avg FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee WHERE (employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave'))

SELECT department_name AS "Department", employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' ELSE 'Recorded annual salary' END AS "Compensation Basis", avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN annual_salary WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) AS "Department Average Annual Compensation", avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary ELSE NULL END) AS "Average Hourly Rate" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee WHERE (employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) GROUP BY department_name, employee_pay_type HAVING avg(CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN annual_salary WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) > CASE WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 150000 WHEN employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 78000 ELSE NULL END

SELECT e.employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", FLOOR((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) / 100000) * 100000 AS "Lower Bound", (FLOOR((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) / 100000) + 1) * 100000 AS "Upper Bound Exclusive", count(*) AS "Employee Count", 100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY e.employee_pay_type) AS "Percent Within Pay Type" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee AS e WHERE (e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) AND TRUE AND TRUE AND NOT ((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) IS NULL) AND ('recorded' = 'recorded' OR (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) > 0) GROUP BY e.employee_pay_type, FLOOR((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) / 100000) ORDER BY "Lower Bound"

SELECT e.employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", count(DISTINCT e.employee_code) AS "Employee Count" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee AS e WHERE (e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) AND TRUE AND TRUE AND (('above' = 'above' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) > 50000) OR ('above' = 'at_least' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) >= 50000) OR ('above' = 'equal' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) = 50000) OR ('above' = 'below' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) < 50000)) GROUP BY e.employee_pay_type

SELECT e.employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", CASE WHEN 'company' = 'department' THEN e.department_name WHEN 'company' = 'status' THEN e.employee_status ELSE 'Company' END AS "Group", uniqExact(e.employee_code) AS "Employee Count", count((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Known Compensation Count", sum((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Annual Compensation Sum", avg((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Average Annual Compensation", min((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Minimum Annual Compensation", max((CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END)) AS "Maximum Annual Compensation", avg(CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary ELSE NULL END) AS "Average Hourly Rate" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee AS e WHERE (e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY e.employee_pay_type, CASE WHEN 'company' = 'department' THEN e.department_name WHEN 'company' = 'status' THEN e.employee_status ELSE 'Company' END ORDER BY "Group"

SELECT e.employee_pay_type AS "Pay Type", CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN 'Estimated annual compensation (2080 hours)' WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN 'Recorded annual salary' ELSE 'Unknown compensation basis' END AS "Compensation Basis", e.employee_code AS "Employee Code", e.department_name AS "Department", e.employee_status AS "Status", (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) AS "Annual Compensation", e.hourly_salary AS "Hourly Rate" FROM dbpcm_warehouse.employee AS e WHERE (e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave') OR e.employee_status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')) AND TRUE AND TRUE AND (('above' = 'above' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) > 50000) OR ('above' = 'at_least' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) >= 50000) OR ('above' = 'equal' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) = 50000) OR ('above' = 'below' AND (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) < 50000)) ORDER BY e.employee_pay_type, (CASE WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Salary' THEN e.annual_salary WHEN e.employee_pay_type = 'Hourly' THEN e.hourly_salary * 2080 ELSE NULL END) DESC, e.employee_code LIMIT 20
